nodes.label: Building Icon
nodes.description: A 24x24 SVG icon depicting a multi-story office building or institutional structure. The icon shows a rectangular building outline with a flat roofline, multiple evenly-spaced rectangular windows arranged in a grid pattern on the facade, and a centered doorway at the base. The design uses a single white filled path on a transparent background, giving it a clean, flat icon style suitable for navigation menus, content management interfaces, or facility/organization-related UI contexts. It communicates concepts of buildings, offices, organizations, or physical locations.
